messages:
Elena (CSE): Customer (ACMECorp) requested SOC2 evidence + SBOM + remediation timeline for a vuln they found in our runtime dependency. They referenced CVE-2025-3366 and want: proof of scan/SBOM, ETA for remediation, and confirmation that KMS rotation/audit will show the deployment.
Maya S. (Security): Which CVE exactly?
Elena (CSE): CVE-2025-3366 in libssl; ticket CS-998: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-998
Raj P. (Eng): Quick triage: looks like an OpenSSL parsing bug. Our service image `service-api:2025.02.12` uses libssl 1.1.1g. We've upgraded some images to 1.1.1l but not all.
Sam (SecOps): Do Dedicated/Private use the same images? We need to know scope for customer-facing guidance.
Raj P. (Eng): Dedicated is pinned to `redwood/dedicated-runtime:2025-01-09` -> also 1.1.1g. Private installs vary by customer; some may be on older bundles.
Maya S. (Security): Risk assessment: network-parsable TLS bug -> treat as P2 for externally-exposed runtimes. Plan: patch hosted ASAP, schedule dedicated backport in 5 business days, and produce mitigation docs for Private customers.
Elena (CSE): They want firm dates to share. Can we commit to hosted + dedicated ETAs and a mitigation recommendation for Private?
Sam (SecOps): Hosted: rolling deploy starts at 1744632000 (~1 hour). Full rollout aim: within 3 hours if health checks pass.
Raj P. (Eng): Dedicated backport + staged rollout targeted by 1745036800 (5 days). For Private: we'll publish an advisory with mitigations and a backport Dockerfile diff.
Maya S. (Security): I'll generate the SBOM (CycloneDX JSON) and export vuln-scan logs, map to SOC2 controls (CC6/CC7). Evidence bundle ETA: 1744635600 (~3 hours).
Elena (CSE): Also need KMS rotation/audit proof that keys were used during deploy — customer explicit ask.
Sam (SecOps): We'll create a manual KMS rotation event tied to the rollout and capture CloudKMS audit entries. I'll paste the audit snippet into CS-998 once available.
Raj P. (Eng): Temporary mitigation: set `OPENSSL_NO_RENEGOTIATION=1` in runtime env to reduce exposure until library update lands.
Maya S. (Security): I'll draft a concise customer response with dates, attach SBOM and vuln logs. @Elena please review before sending.
Elena (CSE): Will do. Planning to send the advisory after we have the SBOM + KMS audit snippet. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Deploy job started for hosted runtime (job id: deploy-7852). CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/deploy-7852
Sam (SecOps): Logged action items in CS-998: patch hosted, backport dedicated, private advisory, SBOM bundle, KMS audit. Owners assigned.
Elena (CSE): Thanks everyone — I'll update ACMECorp in ~30 minutes with the provisional timeline and note we'll follow up with evidence bundle.
